external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues who sign in through the identity broker and use applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
external_entities.notes: Colleagues sign in from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who authenticate through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The source does not state which franchise colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: franchise stores
external_entities.description: Franchise stores whose colleagues are allowed to use the system.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

external_entities.name: own identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by franchise colleagues' organization that vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The source does not identify which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system from which group membership changes and leaver status are supplied overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, accepts federated sign-in, and supplies public signing key material.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The same signing key signs tokens for every application. Tokens are valid for twelve hours and cannot be withdrawn before expiry.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that allows a holder of a token containing the store-manager group to change prices and void transactions for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

processes.name: application
processes.description: An application that accepts the broker-issued token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
processes.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
processes.notes: The store admin console is one of these applications.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store where the identity broker keeps the signing key used to sign tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Group membership comes from the HR system overnight rather than being maintained there by hand.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Colleagues sign in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
data_flows.notes: The source does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Franchise colleagues use their own identity provider's vouching as a sign-in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state the protocol or which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: vouch for sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token carrying a colleague's staff id and groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: Tokens are good for twelve hours and there is no way to pull one back before it expires.

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: Colleagues present the broker-issued token to an application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and groups

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: Colleagues present the broker-issued token to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: A store-manager token works against every store.
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and groups

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: Franchise colleagues present the broker-issued token to an application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token
data_flows.notes: The source does not explicitly state the subsequent application use for franchise colleagues.
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and groups

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: Franchise colleagues present the broker-issued token to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: The source does not explicitly state that franchise colleagues use the store admin console.
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and groups

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: Applications fetch the public half of the signing key from the identity broker to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.notes: The store admin console is one of the applications.

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker reads the signing key it keeps in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: maintain directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains its directory of colleagues and groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group membership and leaver changes from the HR system once a night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: The same overnight process is how leavers stop being colleagues.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.
trust_boundaries.notes: The store admin console also runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: own devices at home
trust_boundaries.description: The home-device environment from which colleagues may sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home
trust_boundaries.notes: The source says colleagues sign in from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled environment associated with franchise colleagues and their own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's data classification is confidential because it contains a signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the identity broker keeps a signing key in the key store; signing keys are secrets.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's data classification is confidential because it contains colleagues and their group membership, including staff identifiers.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory contains colleagues and the groups they are in, and the issued token carries the colleague's staff id.
